submittedParameters.prompt:
EDIT TARGET first reference only for exact camera, pixel scale, skull proportions, finished material and costume; independently redraw one NEW running frame N/02. RIGHT foot loading response: sole remains planted at the exact same ground position as reference01, RIGHT knee visibly bends to absorb weight; hips and skull descend around 18 normalized pixels without size change. LEFT knee folds behind, left heel raised toward camera. Bell-left arm reduces forward swing and cards-right arm begins moving forward from its backward extreme. Both shoulder and elbow angles move, not hands alone.
Square native >=1024, actual transparent alpha, full character same camera distance as first reference, no auto-fit scale. Preserve body proportions and head size and root horizontal center. Real running forward away from camera, chest leans into travel, separate articulated knees and feet, real opposite arm and leg motion. LEFT hand always one brass bell; RIGHT hand always exactly FIVE red gold fire talismans; secure grips. No effects, shadows, floor, text, grid or motion lines. Follow portrait identity and style refs while preserving current batch run frame's scale. No mirror, no warp or 2D moving cutout parts.
